object_context: Let U be the parent complement ground set and y a fixed feasible C024 dual weighting on relevant full semi-filters. Embed U as U0 on the odd-odd slice of a 2M by 2M child. Let U' be any child complement satisfying U' intersect odd-odd = U0. For a child graph edge w in an even row and even column, its row and column complement traces S,T lie outside U0 and are disjoint. The active local question is whether the huge child saturated-neighbourhood condition for one fresh relevant semi-filter K can be reduced to parent tight-pair data, while preserving exact Definition-18--21 semantics.
problem_signature: odd-odd old slice plus off-slice child complement
local obstruction compression only; no recurrence/rate/root promotion
structural_coordinates: A semi-filter is nonempty, upward closed, and excludes the empty set.
Being above a graph edge forces the row-trace and column-trace generators into the semi-filter.
A pair covers a semi-filter exactly when both operands are in the semi-filter but their intersection is not.
The cover graph pair side contains all ordered pairs of subsets of the complement ground set.
Cylinder lift is defined by old-slice projection; old dual load of a child pair is determined by the projected parent pair when the lift is used.
For an even-even child graph edge, the two generator traces are disjoint from the old odd-odd slice and from each other.
Fresh mass is blocked by any child pair whose old lifted load is already one and which covers the fresh semi-filter.
The target statement is a necessary local condition only, not a sufficient augmentation criterion.
No finite computation, recurrence, E-language circuit checkpoint, NP bridge, or root statement is licensed by this atom.
equivalent_formulations: LP residual-capacity view: tight old constraints are zero-slack resources.
Cover-graph view: a fresh filter must avoid every saturated pair neighbourhood.
Projection view: decorate a parent pair with disjoint child generator traces and compare preservation before and after cylinder lifting.
Intersection-absorption view: avoiding decorated tight pairs requires the fresh filter to absorb their old intersections.

explicit_disanalogies_and_boundaries: Even-even is essential for the simple disjoint old/new trace algebra; odd-even and even-odd edges can create cross terms.
The child complement must not add extra odd-odd points, or old graph-edge persistence can fail.
A necessary condition for avoiding one class of saturated child pairs is not sufficient for positive augmentation because other saturated child pairs may remain.
A disjoint tight parent pair is a conditional obstruction; this cycle does not assert that every useful parent dual has one.
Local cover facts do not establish divergence, source-compatible rate, NP membership, a lower-bound-preserving reduction, or P != NP.
